text:
Ava (growth): quick heads-up — I pulled a KPI snapshot tying the new launch blog + webinar traffic to MQLs. noticed a ~22% drop in GCLID-linked leads week-over-week. wondering if this is attribution timing or routing filter.
Sam (ops): can you paste the dashboard link? also did any campaign UTM params change last week?
Ava (growth): https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/kpis?panel=leadflow — no intentional UTM changes that I know of. promo links used the same ?utm_campaign=launch_q2
Riya (analytics): I ran a quick cohort query. numbers below (last 7d vs prev):
```
SELECT count(*) as leads, source, first_touch
FROM lead_events
WHERE created_at >= '2025-03-10'
GROUP BY source, first_touch;
```
Result: total leads down 5%, GCLID-tagged down 22%, organic search flat, paid social up 8%.
Mark (product): that GCLID drop could be an upstream tagging failure in the form. Any form changes pushed last Tuesday? @Sam
Sam (ops): no code deploys to forms. ops logs show successful POSTs. but our GTM snippet did roll out a consent checkbox tweak on Tue (cookie-consent v2). might be blocking click parameter capture for some users.
Riya (analytics): good flag — I plotted capture rate vs consent. early signal: users with consent v2 have 30% lower gclid param capture. looks like consent modal blocks redirect querystring when using the two-step consent flow.
Iris (content): ok — if attribution is underreporting, our webinar benchmark narrative will undersell paid performance. we should delay public benchmark callouts until we confirm fix.
Ava (growth): agree. Let's not update the benchmark blog paragraph about paid CPL until Friday. we can still run the webinar, but update slides to note tentative attribution blip.
dashbot: [alert] dashboard 'Leadflow: Inbound by Source' detected >15% drop in GCLID capture at 2025-03-25T10:44:00Z :warning:
Sam (ops): plan: rollback consent tweak to v1 on staging, verify gclid capture with test flows, then hotfix to prod if confirmed. I can own test + rollback (ETA 4h).
Riya (analytics): I'll run an hourly capture monitor and post a slackhook to this thread with a simple metric: `gclid_capture_rate`. I'll also recompute the webinar->MQL conversion with a 14d attribution window and post numbers.
Mark (product): do we need a dashboard change? maybe a short-term tile that shows 'gclid capture delta' so PMs can see it at-a-glance.
Iris (content): I'll edit the webinar slides to add a small footnote about attribution caveat, and hold the launch case study paragraph that mentions paid efficiency. Draft ready in ~2h.
Ava (growth): leaderboard of actions: Sam rollback/test (4h), Riya hourly monitor + recompute (ongoing), Iris slide update (2h). Ava will delay public benchmark text and sync with sales enablement.
Riya (analytics): posting first recompute in ~1h. if gclid recovers after rollback, we'll backfill numbers and update the benchmark blog with a note on attribution window and consent change.
Sam (ops): doing rollback now on staging, will ping here with logs. :rocket:
Ava (growth): thanks team — appreciate the quick triage. we'll reconvene in this thread after Riya's first run. :thumbsup:
